game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut, a herbalist's hut: the beast tamer must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Choreography: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat.
theme: Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut: a herbalist's hut
core_gameplay_loop: In Herbalist Hut, repeat each round: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat. Each round, giant beetles strike the root gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sync value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the root gate from giant beetles in Herbalist Hut: keep the sync meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: sync drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Loop Choreography
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sync changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Herbalist Hut.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while sync > 0.
